name: 30458 · Statesboro, GA
findings: ZIP 30458 (Statesboro) has 107 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30458 (Statesboro) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 30458 (Statesboro) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).
